title: Honeycomb fisheye launcher
blurb: Twenty-five live HTML mini-controls in a spherical watch-face honeycomb on one ElementGL WebGL 2 canvas. Drag across the dark dial to bring any tile into the magnified centre, or double-tap a tile to focus it.
question: Can 25 live interactive HTML mini-controls sit inside a hexagonal spherical-fisheye cloud where dragging glides any cluster into the magnified centre and updateElementGeometry() keeps every scaled tile directly clickable and tappable?
result: Built on one ElementGL WebGL 2 context uploading 25 drawable tiles via texElementSubImage2D(), spherical dome projection with squircle SDF masking, geometryUnit()-scaled hit-testing with dataset.hitTick cache clearing, inert gating on shrunken rim tiles, and 2D and plain HTML fallbacks. Browser checks not run yet.
